# Third-party art

This prototype uses selected PNG assets from Kenney's free packs:

- UI Pack - Sci-Fi: https://kenney.nl/assets/ui-pack-sci-fi
- Particle Pack: https://kenney.nl/assets/particle-pack
- Simple Space: https://kenney.nl/assets/simple-space

The assets are distributed under Creative Commons CC0. The original license
files are kept next to each pack in this folder.
